notes.title: Update 12/09/2016
notes.content:
Heya my fellow crazy murdering psycho campers,
    I’ve just released the 1.01 Patch. This includes some important fixes and improvements. Here is a short list:
    - Added a Cancel button, when connecting to a game ( in case it takes too long).
    - Increase the number of status checks to reduce state disparity between client and hosts (e.g. the killer with the axe in the camp).
    - Changed the QoS for the game update network channel to reduce disparities.
    - Refactored the client disconnection handling to suit cancelled connect attempts
    - Refactored the code for checking connection info for wrong data. 
    - Fixed a bug where sometimes, when choosing Votekill, the red icon displayed on the same person.


Felipe
